**GPCC Context:** Octree structure for position coding; transform coding context for attributes.
*   Define the bounding box of the Gaussian volume.
*   Merge Gaussians falling into the same voxel.
*   Keep the quantized mean positions $\{\hat{\mu}_i\}_{i=1}^M$ fixed.
